answers.acts: What it acts on: an application for a planning permit on the permit form (permit_application), which it decides under the planning law.

forms.say: An application to build goes on the permit form (permit_application), naming the lot and the kind of building.

issues.does: Decides a permit application (granted, refused, or sent back as incomplete) and tells the applicant. A decision to grant records the permission with it: the applicant's liberty to build that kind of building on that lot, which the building inspector reads. So a grant says the lot and the kind of building, as the application gives them.

applicant.description: Who applied: the decision is sent to them.

decision.description: Granted, refused, or sent back as incomplete.

law.description: The law the building would breach, if any.

lot.description: For a grant: the lot the permission is for, as the application names it.

missing.description: For an incomplete application: what it does not say (lot, structure_type).

reason.description: Why it is decided so, in words, where the law named does not say it (a refusal, or what to send in).

structure_type.description: For a grant: the kind of building permitted, as the application names it.

issues.title: Decision on a planning permit application
